text:
Lena: dropping a new dark-mode pass for the metrics dashboard. attached PNGs in the doc (Dashboard > Dark v2). primary concerns: chart legibility at small sizes, legend contrast, and code block readability.

Arun: saw it. first impression: the stacked area charts lose edge definition on 14" <= avoid heavy blur on fills. could we try a thin stroke + slightly darker fill combo so boundaries read at 1x and 1.25x zoom?

Taylor: +1. also the donut labels use `--muted-text` which is 4.2:1 on panels but overlays on patterned backgrounds — consider a semi-opaque pill behind label.

Rafael: for colorblind-safe palettes, i recommend testing with Coblis and these sets from ColorBrewer: Set2 and Dark2 variants are decent. proposing a 5-color set: `#2b8cbe`, `#f4a261`, `#66c2a5`, `#d53e4f`, `#b2abd2`.

Nora: copy nit: the toggle below says "Low motion" but the tooltip references "reduce visual noise". Let's unify to "Reduce animations" and in tooltip: "Turn off non-essential chart motion for accessibility".

Lena: good call. Nora, could you paste the exact tooltip text you'd like? we'll pass to docs.

Nora: tooltip: "Reduce animations — disable non-essential chart motion for accessibility and performance." short and explicit.

Arun: thinking CSS: remove translucent blur on area fills and add a 1px stroke using a color token variant. quick sample:```css
:root{
  --chart-bg: #06080a;
  --area-fill-alpha: 0.18;
  --series-a: #2b8cbe;
  --series-a-stroke: #1f6f98;
}
/* chart rendering pseudocode */
.area{ fill: color(var(--series-a) alpha(var(--area-fill-alpha))); stroke: var(--series-a-stroke); stroke-width: 1px; }
```

Taylor: legend design thought: use a subtle rounded rect behind each item at 8% opacity of the panel color to help separation. on hover, increase to 14%. Also include focus outline for keyboard navigation (2px solid accent).

Rafael: heatmap gradient: current violet->cyan has midpoints that collapse on greyscale. propose diverging with light neutral center: `#dfeaf6` -> `#4f6fa3` and `#f7e4d3` -> `#c24a3b` for two-tone insight maps.

Lena: can we run an automated a11y check on these palettes before merging? OpsBot, can you queue a check?

OpsBot: a11y-check queued: run id a11y-1723459999. Expected duration ~3m. I'll post results in thread when complete.

Nora: also, code blocks: current token colors are low contrast because font-size in the console is 11px. Options: bump console font to 12px, or increase token contrast. I prefer token tweak to avoid layout shifts.

Arun: Rafael, any objections if we keep terminal mono at 12px for improved legibility? many users use small windows.

Rafael: leaning towards leaving layout but increasing contrast. propose `--code-bg: #0a0c0e` and `--code-plain: #dbe9f7` with keywords bolded slightly.

Taylor: I'll prototype the legend pill + focus ring and add a small toggle to the doc to switch between "current" and "proposed" palettes. want an overlay diff too if possible.

Lena: owners: Arun (chart strokes + code contrast plan), Rafael (palettes + heatmap), Taylor (legend & demo toggle), Nora (copy), Ops (a11y check). timeline: aim to land core palette and legend UI this sprint.

OpsBot: a11y-check complete: 2 warnings, 1 failure. Failure: donut label contrast on patterned background (issue created: UI-4492). Warnings: heatmap greyscale midpoints, legend focus outline not visible in high-contrast mode.

Rafael: filing palette PR now with ColorBrewer variants + test images for Coblis. link in doc when ready.

Nora: I'll update the tooltip/copy and sync with docs team.

Lena: thanks all. small follow-up: can we keep a single source of truth for color tokens in the design tokens repo and reference them from the Redwood tokens package? Sam from platform usually handles that. Rafael, can you coordinate?

Rafael: will loop in Sam.

Taylor: starting the prototype — will post GIFs in the doc for quick review.

Lena: great work. I'll close the mock comments after the PRs land. :sparkles:
